name: us3-markdown-idempotent
description: 016 US3 — reconcile a Markdown-rendered specification twice with no change between runs: the first run creates the epic and story, rendering every Part E construct; the second run recognises both tickets and issues no write of any kind (FR-011, FR-012, SC-004). Both ports must agree on the write counts and produce byte-identical captures (NFR-1).
